metadata.description: Simas's shared agent skills (Agent Skills standard)

plugins.name: blueprint
plugins.description: Define a whole product before development from supplied ideas, notes and source material. Create or update a Blueprint, review requirement gaps, answer delegated questions, apply answers, inspect status or set project depth. Supports Notion and Markdown. Records product intent; does not inspect code or plan implementation. Use blueprint-feature for one change against an existing app.

plugins.name: blueprint-feature
plugins.description: Define one feature or change for an existing app: learn current behavior, write failable requirements, preserve affected behavior, decide ordinary details and surface serious owner decisions. Use to spec a feature, grill it, apply answers or check readiness for planning. Commands: init, add, questions, answer, resolve, status, ready, auto. Not a whole-product PRD, implementation plan or code build.

plugins.name: eng-rulebook
plugins.description: Apply engineering guidance before nontrivial development or refactoring, selecting relevant guides for the task. Emphasizes simple maintainable solutions and meaningful tests. Also use for explicit guide requests, reviewing a change (check), a full codebase audit (audit), a priority-check audit (audit basics), or verifying a previous report (recheck). Audit topics are selected by the agent from the codebase.

plugins.name: mood-board-creator
plugins.description: Explore distinct visual directions for a product as moodboards and realistic screens. Use for moodboards, visual directions, style tiles, art direction, design variants, or a next round from keep/push/kill feedback. Supports normal and thorough modes and lab, standalone or native editable Figma targets. Not production implementation or a design-system build.

plugins.name: ui-craft
plugins.description: Design judgement for any visual work an agent does, so the result is specific to the product and well crafted instead of generic AI output. Use whenever a task changes what a person sees - building or changing pages, screens, components, layouts, styling, landing pages, dashboards, forms, emails, mockups or HTML artifacts; choosing a visual direction; a redesign; or reviewing how something looks - even for a small styling change and even when nobody says "design". Also for "make it look better", "less generic", "more polished", "why does this look AI-made", "review this UI". Commands - direct (set a new visual direction), review (critique existing UI), check (run the rendered checks). Logos, splash screens and multi-variant exploration rounds have their own skills (logo-studio, splash-studio, mood-board-creator); they follow this skill's judgement inside their own process.

plugins.name: wiki-system
plugins.description: Create and maintain compact source-backed codebase maps for coding agents. Use when asked to document a codebase for agents, refresh its navigation map, check documentation freshness, or connect Codex/Claude entry instructions. Commands: init, update, update --full, check, context; aliases: recheck, recheck diff, claude. Supports Git repositories, linked worktrees and sibling-repo workspaces. Documentation refreshes only on request or through a project's own CI wiring (ci); ordinary coding reads relevant pointers without regenerating the map.
